name: filters
title: Filter bar
about: Two shared filters on the features: level 1 and level 2. Every view follows them, each in its own way.

shows.filter 1: level-1 values as a checkbox list; none ticked means All
shows.filter 2: level-2 values as a checkbox list; none ticked means All
shows.option count: features with that value under the other filter; a value with 0 cannot be ticked
shows.scope toggle: whether the views of the selected clusters show the filtered features or all their features

reads.level1: refreshes the counts of both lists
reads.level2: refreshes the counts of both lists
reads.scope: shows which side of the toggle is on

features.name: level1
features.how: keeps the features whose level-1 value is ticked; a feature with no value passes only on All

features.name: level2
features.how: keeps the features whose level-2 value is ticked; a feature with no value passes only on All

features.name: sample_group
features.how: reads the timepoint columns of one sample group only; this is a choice of the analysis, the page has no control for it

actions.words: show {param} features of the selected clusters
